title: British Empire
summary: In 1600 Elizabeth I granted London merchants a royal charter with exclusive rights over English trade east of the Cape of Good Hope, founding the East India Company. In the mid-1700s Britain grew from a minor player on the world stage to a dominant superpower, enriched by trade with its North American colonies and strengthened by victory in the Seven Years' War, and it went on to colonize India. Hong Kong's return to China on 1 July 1997 ended British rule there.

uncertainty.note: Dated from the royal chartering of the East India Company in 1600 to the reversion of Hong Kong in 1997, marking the end of Britain's major overseas colonial empire.
